title: Chess.com will catch you anyway
post: Hans said chess speaks for itself. Chess.com was listening 🕵️ How many points did YOU get back? #chess #chesscom #hansniemann #magnuscarlsen #fairplay

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"

phrases.text: A vibr*tor has been accused of beating Magnus Carlsen.
phrases.say: [intense] A vibrator has been accused of beating Magnus Carlsen.

phrases.text: Hans Niemann offered to play n*ked.
phrases.say: Hans Niemann offered to play naked.

phrases.text: Then Magnus resigned against him after one move.
phrases.say: [intense] Then Magnus resigned against him after one move.

phrases.text: Chess.com later said his opponent likely cheated in over a hundred online games.
phrases.say: Chess dot com later said his opponent likely cheated in over a hundred online games.

phrases.text: But Chess.com's clue wasn't a vibr*tor. He played better when he clicked away from the board.
phrases.say: But Chess dot com's clue wasn't a vibrator. He played better when he clicked away from the board.

phrases.text: Hans said chess speaks for itself.
phrases.say: Hans said: chess speaks for itself.

phrases.text: That's trap one. There are three more.
phrases.say: That's trap one. There are three more.

phrases.text: Two: it knows how often players at your rating find the best move.
phrases.say: Two: it knows how often players at your rating find the best move.

phrases.text: Find it more often, and you stand out.
phrases.say: Find it more often... and you stand out.

phrases.text: Three: one engine move per game? Over a hundred games, that's a pattern.
phrases.say: Three: one engine move per game? Over a hundred games... that's a pattern.

phrases.text: Four: your opponents. In October, they sent 1.4 million reports.
phrases.say: Four: your opponents. In October, they sent one point four million reports.
Almost two hundred eighty-two thousand accounts... closed.

phrases.text: And the points you lost to cheating? Chess.com gives them back.
phrases.say: And the points you lost to cheating? Chess dot com gives them back.
Sixty-nine million points. In one month.

phrases.text: Magnus resigned after one move. Chess.com never resigns.
phrases.say: Magnus resigned after one move. [confident] Chess dot com never resigns.

phrases.text: How many points has Chess.com given you back?
phrases.say: How many points has Chess dot com given you back?

_voice_notes: Takes chosen with tools/voice_check.py --takes: each reading ends in silence and is heard word for word; hook 1, clue default, trap1 3, three 2, never 4, twist 1. 'closed' reads 0.86 only because whisper writes the number as digits. 'a cheater' sounded like 'a cheetah' in every take (non-rhotic): the line now says 'lost to cheating'.
